speaker: Doctor
text:
The blood type mismatch (Mother Rh-negative, Baby Rh-positive) combined with low reticulocytes suggests an issue with red blood cell destruction or production. Do you notice any bruising, petechiae, or swelling on the baby's body?

REQUEST TEST: Coombs_Direct
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Ultrasound

speaker: Doctor
text:
The Coombs test is negative and the ultrasound is normal, which helps rule out hemolytic disease and structural abdominal issues. Since the reticulocyte count is low and there is no hemolysis, do you have any history of difficult delivery, specifically regarding cephalohematoma or bruising?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Hemorrhagic Disease (Subgaleal Hemorrhage)
